title: Gam3THub
tagline: Gam3THub: The Ultimate Open-Source Web3 Gaming Hub for Quests, Airdrops, and Rewards
description:
Gam3THub is an open-source Web3 gaming hub platform that empowers users to engage with Web3 games, earn rewards, and easily navigate the decentralized gaming world.

- Using Dynamic for onboarding: Effortlessly onboard users into Web3 by utilizing Dynamic's smooth user registration and authentication system.
- Using Flow for Rewards and Airdrop: Players can complete in-game quests and earn rewards through Flow-based airdrops, giving them real-world value in the form of tokens or NFTs in the future.
- Using Blockscout Transaction Explorer: Transparently track and explore every transaction and event happening within the platform via Blockscout, making the entire gaming experience verifiable and secure.
how_its_made:
- combines the power of Dynamic for seamless onboarding
- Flow for rewarding players through quests and airdrops
- and Blockscout to explore and track every transaction in the ecosystem.
